title: Partner Universities – Högskolan på Åland
text:
Skip to main content
Below you can find Åland UAS partner universities. When applying to Åland UAS contact the international coordinator or Erasmus coordinator at your home university in order to ensure that there is an Erasmus partner agreement between the two institutions. Nordplus exchanges can in some cases also be eligible for Erasmus+ exchange.
